about: Hair-chain presets for tools/hair/build_chains.py. Physical and scale-free: radius in cm, damping and velocity_damping per second, limit in degrees, every stiffness a per-iteration fraction at the solver block's rate. [root, tip] values interpolate along a chain. See docs/hair/PRESETS.md.

bob.description: cheek-length bob of 4-6 bone chains, 12-19 cm long, hanging off the crown. Fitted 2026-10-21 to a reference bone-chain simulation of such a bob (our own UE AnimDynamics tuning of Eve 2B, owner-accepted for form), at the solver block below and the game runtime defaults (r_hairFeel 1, r_hairFlow 1)
